clips.text: 金曜日の昼休み。休憩室で、同僚が音楽を聞いていた。
clips.speaker: narrator
clips.instruction: Quiet, unhurried scene-setting. Reads the room, never addresses anyone.
clips.deliveryIntent: Opens the story from the cover. Unhurried, no warmth.

clips.text: あ、おつかれさまです。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: A greeting on noticing someone. Brief, not performed.

clips.text: おつかれさまです。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: Plain and even; a free ride that models the register.

clips.text: そのTシャツ、何のバンドですか。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: Curious, a little tentative at the head of the line.

clips.text: 高校のときからずっと好きなバンドなんですよ。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Fond, slightly amused at herself. The warmest line in stage 1.

clips.text: 私もロック、好きなんです。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: Offering something about yourself; small lift on 好き.

clips.text: じつは私、ギターをやってるんですよ。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: A small confession she is pleased to make; じつは carries it.

clips.text: 自動販売機の前に、缶コーヒーが二つ並んだ。
clips.speaker: narrator
clips.instruction: Quiet, unhurried scene-setting. Reads the room, never addresses anyone.
clips.deliveryIntent: Quiet, marking that the break has settled.

clips.text: ふだんはどんなの聞くんですか。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Genuine curiosity, casual. ふだん should sound offhand.

clips.text: ギターの音が好きで、よくロックを聞きます。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: The longest learner line. Even pace, a clear break at the comma.

clips.text: ギターがいいと、それだけで聞いちゃいますよね。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Opinionated and companionable; the よね reaches for agreement.

clips.text: じゃあ、おすすめはなんですか。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: Asking someone who clearly knows more. Light questioning rise.

clips.text: ちょうど土曜日にライブがあるんですよ。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: The hinge of the story. Offhand, as if it just occurred to her.

clips.text: 小さいライブハウスなんですけど、音がいいんですよ。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Fondly qualifying — small place, good sound.

clips.text: 夕方、会社の玄関でまた会った。
clips.speaker: narrator
clips.instruction: Quiet, unhurried scene-setting. Reads the room, never addresses anyone.
clips.deliveryIntent: Marks the jump to evening. Flatter than the other three cards.

clips.text: あ、さっきの話なんですけど。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Catching someone on the way out. Slight rise on けど.

clips.text: じつは、チケットが一枚あまってるんです。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Matter-of-fact, not pleading. She is offering, not asking a favour.

clips.text: 私も行ってもいいですか。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: Asking permission to join. Polite, a little hopeful.

clips.text: ぜひ、一緒に行きましょう。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Warm and immediate. ぜひ is the whole line.

clips.text: チケットはいくらですか。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: Practical question, no hesitation.

clips.text: 三千円ですけど、当日でいいですよ。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Practical, reassuring on the second half.

clips.text: 外は、もう暗くなっていた。
clips.speaker: narrator
clips.instruction: Quiet, unhurried scene-setting. Reads the room, never addresses anyone.
clips.deliveryIntent: The quietest of the four cards.

clips.text: 土曜日、六時でいいですか。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Checking, not proposing. Small rise at the end.

clips.text: じゃあ、どこで待ち合わせしますか。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: Settling a detail. Even, unhurried.

clips.text: 駅の東口はどうですか。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Easy suggestion, no emphasis.

clips.text: 楽しみにしています。
clips.speaker: learner
clips.instruction: Even, clearly spaced, unhurried. The learner imitates this reading directly.
clips.deliveryIntent: The closing beat of the learner's arc. Warm, unhurried.

clips.text: では、また土曜日に。
clips.speaker: coworker
clips.instruction: Warm and quick, like someone glad to be talking about this. Friendly polite, never deferential.
clips.deliveryIntent: Closing beat, lighter and shorter than everything before it.
